identity.subtitle: Research & Engineering Portfolio
identity.summary: A student research and engineering portfolio centered on security, software systems, embedded devices, communication flows, and Linux infrastructure. The work emphasizes testable prototypes, system records, security considerations, and evidence-based iteration.
identity.summaryZh: 以資安為核心，整合軟體、嵌入式裝置、通訊與 Linux 基礎設施，將真實問題轉化為可測試、可記錄與可持續改善的系統原型。

homepageFocus.title: High Performance Computing
homepageFocus.description: Learning HPC workflows through Linux, MPI, GPU experiments, and scientific computing records, with a focus on making complex environments reproducible and explainable.
homepageFocus.descriptionJa: Linux、MPI、GPU 実験、科学計算の記録を通じて HPC のワークフローを学び、複雑な環境を再現し説明できる形に整理しています。
homepageFocus.descriptionZh: 透過 Linux、MPI、GPU 實驗與科學計算紀錄學習 HPC 流程，重點放在讓複雜環境可重現、可解釋。

homepageFocus.title: Cloud Communication
homepageFocus.description: Exploring how devices, services, notifications, and remote access can communicate reliably without exposing sensitive data or unnecessary attack surface.
homepageFocus.descriptionJa: デバイス、サービス、通知、リモートアクセスを、安全で不要な攻撃面を増やさない形でつなぐ方法を探索しています。
homepageFocus.descriptionZh: 探索裝置、服務、通知與遠端存取如何可靠通訊，同時避免暴露敏感資料與不必要攻擊面。

homepageFocus.title: Systems Infrastructure
homepageFocus.description: Building a personal lab around Linux services, Docker, routing, monitoring, recovery notes, and operational failure records.
homepageFocus.descriptionJa: Linux サービス、Docker、ルーティング、監視、復旧記録、運用上の失敗記録を中心に個人実験環境を構築しています。
homepageFocus.descriptionZh: 以 Linux 服務、Docker、路由、監控、恢復筆記與操作失敗紀錄建立個人實驗環境。

homepageFocus.title: Cybersecurity as a Supporting Discipline
homepageFocus.titleJa: 支援領域としてのサイバーセキュリティ
homepageFocus.description: Using security thinking to support identity, authorization, network boundaries, service exposure, audit records, and system reliability.
homepageFocus.descriptionJa: 認証、認可、ネットワーク境界、サービス公開範囲、監査記録、システム信頼性を支えるためにセキュリティの考え方を使っています。
homepageFocus.descriptionZh: 以資安思維支援身分、授權、網路邊界、服務暴露、稽核紀錄與系統可靠性設計。

areas.name: Healthcare Cybersecurity
areas.description: Healthcare information systems, clinical workflows, identity verification, device trust, and audit records.
areas.descriptionZh: 醫療資訊系統、臨床流程、身分驗證、裝置可信度與稽核紀錄。

areas.name: Infrastructure Security
areas.description: Home lab, Linux, Docker, OpenWrt, network topology, monitoring, and defensive operations.
areas.descriptionZh: Home Lab、Linux、Docker、OpenWrt、網路架構、服務監控與防禦。

areas.nameZh: 嵌入式與 IoT 安全
areas.description: ESP32, Raspberry Pi, BLE, MQTT, device reporting, firmware behavior, and communication security.
areas.descriptionZh: ESP32、Raspberry Pi、BLE、MQTT、裝置回報、韌體與通訊安全。

areas.name: Applied Web Security
areas.description: Web attack surfaces, authentication, authorization, secure APIs, and platform design.
areas.descriptionZh: Web 攻擊面、身分驗證、權限管理、安全 API 與平台設計。

areas.name: High Performance Computing

areas.descriptionZh: Linux、MPI、GPU、平行運算與科學模擬的學習與教學轉化。

projects.title: SecureCare
projects.summary: A healthcare cybersecurity prototype focused on identity, device trust, audit logs, and abnormal event reporting.
projects.summaryZh: 以身分驗證、裝置可信度、稽核紀錄與異常回報為核心的醫療資安原型。
listingSummary: Built with FastAPI, MQTT, SQLite, and ESP32-style device communication for healthcare information and device integration.
The idea comes from the need to manage clinical records, device events, and account permissions more reliably.
The current prototype covers backend APIs, device communication, audit records, and basic security flows.
listingSummaryZh: 使用 FastAPI、MQTT、SQLite 與 ESP32 建立的醫療資訊與裝置整合系統。
這個想法來自臨床紀錄、裝置事件與帳號權限需要更可靠的管理。
目前先完成後端、裝置通訊、稽核紀錄與基本安全流程。
projects.researchQuestion: How can nursing record workload be reduced while preserving identity verification, device trust, auditability, and abnormal event reporting?
projects.researchQuestionZh: 如何在降低護理紀錄負擔的同時，保留身分驗證、裝置可信度、稽核與異常回報能力？
projects.problem: Clinical data and device events need trust boundaries that remain usable under time pressure.
projects.problemZh: 臨床資料與裝置事件需要可信邊界，但同時必須適應醫療現場的時間壓力。
projects.approach: FastAPI, JWT, RBAC, MQTT, HMAC signing, replay protection, and audit log design.
projects.approachZh: FastAPI、JWT、RBAC、MQTT、HMAC 簽章、Replay Protection 與 Audit Log 設計。
projects.limitations: Prototype stage; clinical deployment, user testing, and formal security evaluation are not complete.
projects.limitationsZh: 目前仍為原型階段，尚未完成臨床部署、使用者測試與正式安全評估。
projects.nextSteps: Organize system architecture, document threat assumptions, and separate public evidence from private implementation details.
projects.nextStepsZh: 整理系統架構、威脅假設，並區分可公開證據與私有實作細節。
projects.myRole: System design, backend implementation, security workflow, and device integration
keyDecisions: Separate user identity from device trust
Keep auditability visible in the prototype
challenges: Clinical workflow assumptions need careful validation
Private implementation details must be sanitized before public release
testing: API behavior and device flow tests are being organized
lessons: Security controls must fit time-constrained workflows
projects.contextZh: 此系統以醫療紀錄與裝置事件流程作為原型情境，用來整理身分驗證、權限控制、裝置信任、稽核紀錄與異常回報之間的關係；目前仍屬個人研究準備與工程原型，不代表正式臨床部署。
projects.myRoleZh: 系統架構規劃、後端實作、安全流程設計、裝置通訊整合與文件整理

trustBoundariesZh.name: 使用者身分區域
trustBoundariesZh.purpose: 處理登入、身分驗證與使用者操作脈絡。
trustBoundariesZh.securityConsideration: 身分驗證與授權不可混在一起，必須分開檢查。

trustBoundariesZh.name: 後端 API 區域
trustBoundariesZh.purpose: 集中處理資料驗證、權限控制與稽核紀錄。
trustBoundariesZh.securityConsideration: API 必須避免未授權存取與不完整的輸入驗證。

trustBoundariesZh.name: 裝置通訊區域
trustBoundariesZh.purpose: 接收裝置事件與狀態回報。
trustBoundariesZh.securityConsideration: 裝置訊息需要簽章、時間或序號假設，避免簡單重送。

trustBoundariesZh.name: 稽核與儲存區域
trustBoundariesZh.purpose: 保留可追蹤的操作與異常紀錄。
trustBoundariesZh.securityConsideration: 稽核紀錄必須避免被任意修改，且不能公開敏感內容。

securityConsiderationsZh.name: 身分驗證
securityConsiderationsZh.purpose: 確認使用者身分並建立可追蹤的操作脈絡。
securityConsiderationsZh.currentApproach: 使用 JWT 作為原型階段的身分驗證機制。
securityConsiderationsZh.limitation: 尚未完成正式臨床使用情境的身分管理驗證。

securityConsiderationsZh.name: 授權／權限控制
securityConsiderationsZh.purpose: 限制不同角色可執行的操作。
securityConsiderationsZh.currentApproach: 以 RBAC 概念整理 API 權限。
securityConsiderationsZh.limitation: 角色模型仍需要與真實流程比對。

securityConsiderationsZh.name: 裝置信任
securityConsiderationsZh.purpose: 降低偽造裝置訊息或不可信回報的風險。
securityConsiderationsZh.currentApproach: 使用 HMAC 簽章與重送防護假設整理裝置訊息。
securityConsiderationsZh.limitation: 尚未完成正式韌體與金鑰管理設計。

securityConsiderationsZh.name: 稽核紀錄
securityConsiderationsZh.purpose: 保留可追蹤的操作、異常與系統事件。
securityConsiderationsZh.currentApproach: 在原型中整理 Audit Log 欄位與事件流程。
securityConsiderationsZh.limitation: 尚未完成防竄改與長期保存機制。

failureCaseDetailsZh.context: 使用者嘗試執行不符合角色權限的操作。
failureCaseDetailsZh.investigation: 檢查 API 權限檢查與 RBAC 規則。
failureCaseDetailsZh.response: 將權限失敗納入測試與稽核紀錄。
failureCaseDetailsZh.lesson: 權限錯誤應被明確拒絕並留下可追蹤紀錄。

failureCaseDetailsZh.context: 裝置或攻擊者重送先前的有效訊息。
failureCaseDetailsZh.investigation: 檢查簽章、時間或序號假設。
failureCaseDetailsZh.response: 將重送防護列為裝置通訊設計重點。
failureCaseDetailsZh.lesson: 簽章只能證明來源假設，仍需處理重送情境。

failureCaseDetailsZh.context: 裝置中斷連線後無法即時回報狀態。
failureCaseDetailsZh.investigation: 檢查 MQTT 流程與裝置狀態回報。
failureCaseDetailsZh.response: 將離線狀態列入後續測試。
failureCaseDetailsZh.lesson: 裝置可信度包含連線狀態與失敗處理，不只是通訊成功。

failureCaseDetailsZh.context: 後端收到簽章不符合預期的裝置訊息。
failureCaseDetailsZh.investigation: 檢查 HMAC 驗證與訊息格式。
failureCaseDetailsZh.response: 拒絕訊息並保留異常紀錄。
failureCaseDetailsZh.lesson: 安全控制必須同時考慮拒絕策略與可觀察性。

validationChecksZh.purpose: 確認後端在正常與異常請求下的回應。
確認角色不應執行的操作會被拒絕。
確認裝置訊息格式、簽章與重送情境。
確認關鍵操作與異常事件會被記錄。

evidenceRegistryZh.title: SecureCare API 與裝置流程原型
evidenceRegistryZh.description: 原型證據存在，但公開前需要移除內部細節。

evidenceRegistryZh.title: SecureCare 架構與安全假設
evidenceRegistryZh.description: 正在整理架構、威脅假設、限制與下一步。

evidenceRegistryZh.title: 醫療流程觀察筆記
evidenceRegistryZh.description: 為避免公開個人或敏感脈絡，相關筆記不公開。

engineeringDecisionsZh.decision: 分離使用者身分與裝置信任
engineeringDecisionsZh.reason: 使用者登入成功不代表裝置訊息可信。
engineeringDecisionsZh.tradeoff: 需要額外設計裝置簽章、金鑰與重送防護。

engineeringDecisionsZh.reason: 醫療與安全情境需要能追蹤誰在何時做了什麼。
engineeringDecisionsZh.tradeoff: 必須控制紀錄內容，避免保存過多敏感資料。

engineeringDecisionsZh.reason: 原型能用來驗證流程與安全假設。
engineeringDecisionsZh.tradeoff: 不能把原型描述成正式產品或臨床部署。

limitationsDetailedZh: 目前是工程原型，不是正式醫療系統。
尚未完成臨床部署、使用者測試與正式資安評估。
裝置金鑰管理與韌體安全仍需深化。
稽核紀錄尚未完成防竄改與長期保存設計。
公開文件需要移除內部實作與敏感脈絡。
lessonsDetailedZh: 安全控制必須符合時間壓力下的使用流程。
身分驗證、授權、裝置信任與稽核紀錄需要分層設計。
原型可以驗證假設，但不能取代正式測試。
公開成果需要清楚區分證據、限制與未完成項目。
subQuestionsZh: 如何在不增加過多操作負擔下保留身分驗證與稽核紀錄？
如何判斷裝置回報是否可信？
如何處理重送訊息、錯誤權限與裝置離線？
哪些資料可以公開作為證據，哪些必須保持 private？
futureResearchZh: 設計更清楚的裝置信任流程
區分公開文件與 private implementation details
探索醫療資訊安全與臨床流程的交界
projects.nextEngineeringStepZh: 整理可公開的架構文件、威脅假設與測試證據，並分離 private implementation details。
projects.nextEngineeringStep: Publish sanitized architecture notes and organize test evidence
relatedNotes: 護理師讓我重新思考醫療資安

projects.title: Home Lab Infrastructure
projects.summary: A personal infrastructure environment for repeatable deployment, monitoring, failure recovery, and security experiments.
projects.summaryZh: 用於反覆部署、監控、故障復原與安全實驗的個人基礎設施環境。
listingSummary: Built with Raspberry Pi, Linux, Docker, OpenWrt, and MQTT as a personal lab environment.
It is used to test networking, services, remote access, device communication, and security design.
Topology notes, service records, and troubleshooting workflows are still being organized.
listingSummaryZh: 使用 Raspberry Pi、Linux、Docker、OpenWrt 與 MQTT 建立的個人實驗環境。
主要用來測試網路、服務、遠端連線、裝置通訊與資安設計。
目前持續整理拓樸、服務紀錄與故障排查流程。
projects.researchQuestion: What learning environment is needed to repeatedly test networking, system, and security assumptions?
projects.researchQuestionZh: 需要什麼樣的學習環境，才能反覆驗證網路、系統與安全假設？
projects.problem: Reading notes alone cannot expose operational failure modes in networks and services.
projects.problemZh: 只有閱讀筆記無法看見網路與服務在實際運作中的失效模式。
projects.approach: Linux services, Docker isolation, OpenWrt routing, monitoring habits, and written experiment logs.
projects.approachZh: Linux 服務、Docker 隔離、OpenWrt 路由、監控習慣與實驗紀錄。
projects.limitations: Topology and internal service details are private until sanitized.
projects.limitationsZh: 拓樸與內部服務細節在整理與去識別前不公開。
projects.nextSteps: Publish a sanitized architecture summary and experiment index.
projects.nextStepsZh: 公開去識別後的架構摘要與實驗索引。
projects.systemSubtitleZh: 個人基礎設施與資安實驗環境
projects.systemPositioning: A personal infrastructure and security lab for experimenting with Linux services, network architecture, device communication, remote access, service recovery and security boundaries.
projects.systemPositioningZh: 用於 Linux 服務、網路架構、裝置通訊、遠端管理、服務恢復與安全邊界實驗的個人基礎設施環境。
projects.myRole: Architecture planning, Linux configuration, network configuration, service deployment, device integration, remote access exploration, monitoring, troubleshooting, and documentation

nodes.label: SSH / XRDP / Tailscale or WireGuard exploration
OpenWrt / ASUS Router / Xiaomi Router environment

projects.problemDefinition: A repeatable environment is needed to understand Linux host and service deployment, IoT device reporting, MQTT message flow, router and subnet configuration, remote access, fixed IP behavior, connection failures after network changes, service interruption and recovery, device offline states, and separation between sensitive data and non-sensitive notifications.
projects.context: Built with Raspberry Pi and existing routers for personal learning and project validation. It remains logically and operationally separated from healthcare prototypes such as SecureCare while network architecture, monitoring and recovery practices are still being organized.
goals: Build a stable Linux experiment host
Receive ESP32 or other device messages
Set fixed IP and service addressing
nonGoals: No public exposure of all internal services
Telegram is not used as a sensitive data transport
No claim of complete zero-trust architecture
No claim of formal security audit completion

trustBoundaries.name: External Client Zone
trustBoundaries.securityConsideration: Avoid exposing unnecessary services directly to the public network.

trustBoundaries.name: Router / Gateway Zone
trustBoundaries.purpose: Routing, wireless access and network boundary control.
trustBoundaries.securityConsideration: Configuration errors can interrupt management access or expose services.

trustBoundaries.name: Internal Network Zone
trustBoundaries.purpose: Separate lab services and devices from unrelated networks where possible.
trustBoundaries.securityConsideration: Topology changes need documentation and recovery paths.

trustBoundaries.name: Linux Host Zone
trustBoundaries.securityConsideration: Host access, service accounts and updates need continued management.

trustBoundaries.name: Container / Service Zone
trustBoundaries.purpose: Isolate services and make deployment more repeatable.
trustBoundaries.securityConsideration: Container networking and credentials must be documented.

trustBoundaries.name: Device Zone
trustBoundaries.purpose: Receive telemetry and status from lab devices.
trustBoundaries.securityConsideration: Offline, reconnect and message validation behavior need further testing.

securityConsiderations.name: Network Segmentation
securityConsiderations.purpose: Separate lab devices, infrastructure services and unrelated networks where possible.
securityConsiderations.currentApproach: Use router and LAN configuration experiments while documenting topology.
securityConsiderations.limitation: Complete segmentation verification is not finished.

securityConsiderations.name: Service Exposure
securityConsiderations.purpose: Avoid exposing internal dashboards or brokers unnecessarily.
securityConsiderations.currentApproach: Prefer local or private access to internal services.
securityConsiderations.limitation: Exposure review must be repeated after topology changes.

securityConsiderations.name: Remote Access
securityConsiderations.purpose: Prefer authenticated private access over direct public exposure.
securityConsiderations.currentApproach: Compare SSH, XRDP, Tailscale and WireGuard-style approaches.
securityConsiderations.limitation: A final remote access pattern is still being evaluated.

securityConsiderations.name: Credentials
securityConsiderations.purpose: Separate passwords, keys and service credentials.
securityConsiderations.currentApproach: Keep credentials out of public documentation.
securityConsiderations.limitation: Secret management practice still needs deeper organization.

securityConsiderations.name: Sensitive Data Handling
securityConsiderations.purpose: Keep sensitive information inside the local environment.
securityConsiderations.currentApproach: Use the lab for learning and non-sensitive system state only.
securityConsiderations.limitation: No formal sensitive-data workflow is claimed.

securityConsiderations.name: Notification Boundary
securityConsiderations.purpose: Only send non-sensitive status summaries through Telegram.
securityConsiderations.currentApproach: Telegram notification is planned for minimized status summaries.
securityConsiderations.limitation: Message content policy and implementation are not complete.

securityConsiderations.name: Router Security
securityConsiderations.purpose: Review outdated firmware, management interfaces and unnecessary services.
securityConsiderations.currentApproach: Document router environment and configuration risk during experiments.
securityConsiderations.limitation: Some older router firmware may stop receiving security updates.

securityConsiderations.name: Logging
securityConsiderations.purpose: Retain enough records to understand failures and service behavior.
securityConsiderations.currentApproach: Use experiment notes and service status checks.

securityConsiderations.name: Recovery
securityConsiderations.purpose: Document how to restore access after router or service configuration errors.
securityConsiderations.currentApproach: Record recovery steps after configuration failures.
securityConsiderations.limitation: Recovery procedures still need a cleaner public index.

failureCaseDetails.failure: Remote connection unavailable outside the home network
failureCaseDetails.context: External environments cannot directly reach the Home Lab.
failureCaseDetails.investigation: Checked network location, remote access method and routing assumptions.
failureCaseDetails.response: Exploring private remote access through Tailscale or WireGuard-style approaches.
failureCaseDetails.lesson: Remote access must be designed together with recovery and exposure control.

failureCaseDetails.context: Router settings changes made the management interface unavailable.
failureCaseDetails.investigation: Checked network interfaces, IP and LAN configuration.
failureCaseDetails.response: Recovered a manageable state before continuing configuration changes.
failureCaseDetails.lesson: Keep a recovery path before changing network configuration.

failureCaseDetails.context: After reinstalling or replacing a device, SSH reported a host key mismatch.
failureCaseDetails.investigation: Confirmed the device identity before modifying local SSH records.
failureCaseDetails.response: Removed the old known_hosts record and reconnected after verification.
failureCaseDetails.lesson: Do not ignore host key warnings before confirming host identity.

failureCaseDetails.context: Initial flows.json or service deployment did not take effect as expected.
failureCaseDetails.investigation: Checked service status, flow file placement and redeployment method.
failureCaseDetails.response: Adjusted deployment process and recorded the issue.
failureCaseDetails.lesson: Automation flows need deployment notes, not only visual flow design.

failureCaseDetails.failure: Device offline or unable to reconnect
failureCaseDetails.context: Devices may stop reporting after network changes, service interruption or restart.
failureCaseDetails.investigation: Reviewing reconnect, buffering and retry behavior.
failureCaseDetails.response: Planning reconnect and possible message buffering mechanisms.
failureCaseDetails.lesson: A successful device connection is not the same as reliable device behavior.

failureCaseDetails.context: OpenWrt, ASUS or Xiaomi router topology changes can interrupt access.
failureCaseDetails.investigation: Checked topology, management IP and recovery steps.
failureCaseDetails.response: Record topology and restore steps before further changes.
failureCaseDetails.lesson: Router, host, container and device issues must be debugged layer by layer.

validationChecks.purpose: Confirm services are reachable inside the lab network.
Confirm message broker can receive device data.
Confirm automation flow service is available.
Confirm lab devices can report status or telemetry.
Evaluate remote administration without direct public exposure.
Keep Telegram messages limited to non-sensitive summaries.

evidenceRegistry.title: Network topology notes
evidenceRegistry.description: Sanitized topology notes are being organized without internal addresses.

evidenceRegistry.title: Router relationship documentation
evidenceRegistry.description: Documents how existing routers are used in the lab environment.

evidenceRegistry.title: Docker service configuration
evidenceRegistry.description: Container setup notes can be shared after removing sensitive paths and secrets.

evidenceRegistry.title: MQTT and Node-RED configuration notes
evidenceRegistry.description: Tracks broker and automation setup without exposing credentials.

evidenceRegistry.title: Service status output
evidenceRegistry.description: Used as operational evidence for service checks.

evidenceRegistry.title: Device message reports
evidenceRegistry.description: Records whether lab devices publish and recover after interruption.

evidenceRegistry.title: Router recovery notes
evidenceRegistry.description: Records recovery from router configuration mistakes.

evidenceRegistry.title: SSH host key fix
evidenceRegistry.description: Records the correct response to host key mismatch after confirming device identity.

evidenceRegistry.title: Security boundaries and recovery procedures
evidenceRegistry.description: Organizes boundaries, recovery steps and non-sensitive notification planning.

engineeringDecisions.reason: Low-cost, low-power Linux platform suitable for persistent experiments.
engineeringDecisions.tradeoff: Limited resources compared with a full server.

engineeringDecisions.reason: Separate services and simplify repeatable deployment.
engineeringDecisions.tradeoff: Adds container networking and storage complexity.

engineeringDecisions.reason: Lightweight communication for device telemetry and status.
engineeringDecisions.tradeoff: Requires authentication, access control and reconnect handling.

engineeringDecisions.reason: Quickly connect device messages, automation and notifications.
engineeringDecisions.tradeoff: Flows need documentation and controlled credential handling.

engineeringDecisions.reason: Provides visibility and control over lab network configuration.
engineeringDecisions.tradeoff: Incorrect configuration can interrupt network access.

engineeringDecisions.reason: Reduce direct public exposure of internal services.
engineeringDecisions.tradeoff: Requires additional identity, routing and recovery planning.

engineeringDecisions.reason: Deliver non-sensitive system summaries to a phone.
engineeringDecisions.tradeoff: Sensitive data must remain local and message content must be minimized.

limitationsDetailed: Monitoring and alerting are still being built
Remote access approach is still being compared or tested
Some older router firmware may stop receiving security updates
Key and credential management still needs deeper work
Complete network segmentation verification is not finished
No formal vulnerability scanning or penetration test is complete
Device offline buffering is not fully implemented
Telegram notification remains planned or early-stage
No formal medical or sensitive data is processed
lessonsDetailed: Network changes need a recovery path before modification
Fixed IP, service naming and topology documentation reduce debugging cost
A successful device connection is not the same as service reliability
Remote access must consider both security and recoverability
Router, host, container and device issues need layered troubleshooting
Sensitive data and notification summaries must be separated
The value of a Home Lab is not only running services, but recording failures and repairs
Automation flows also need permission and credential management

researchPerspective.question: How can a low-cost personal environment provide a repeatable, observable, recoverable and basically bounded platform for device and service experiments?
subQuestions: How can internal services be managed safely from outside?
How can router configuration mistakes avoid causing long disconnection?
How can devices reconnect or resend data after interruption?
How can sensitive data be separated from status summaries that leave the local environment?
How can service and device health be recorded?
How can limited hardware support a repeatable teaching environment?

failureCaseDetailsZh.failure: 外部網路無法連回 Home Lab
failureCaseDetailsZh.context: 在外部環境無法直接連回 Home Lab。
failureCaseDetailsZh.investigation: 檢查網路位置、遠端存取方式與路由假設。
failureCaseDetailsZh.response: 探索透過 Tailscale 或 WireGuard 類型方式建立 private remote access。
failureCaseDetailsZh.lesson: 遠端存取必須同時考慮復原能力與暴露面控制。

failureCaseDetailsZh.context: 修改路由器設定後，管理介面無法正常連線。
failureCaseDetailsZh.investigation: 檢查網路介面、IP 與 LAN 設定。
failureCaseDetailsZh.response: 先恢復可管理狀態，再繼續調整設定。
failureCaseDetailsZh.lesson: 修改網路設定前必須保留復原路徑。

failureCaseDetailsZh.context: 重新安裝或更換裝置後，SSH 顯示 host key mismatch。
failureCaseDetailsZh.investigation: 先確認裝置身分，再修改本機 SSH 記錄。
failureCaseDetailsZh.response: 確認後移除舊 known_hosts 記錄並重新連線。
failureCaseDetailsZh.lesson: 不可在未確認主機身分時直接忽略 host key 警告。

failureCaseDetailsZh.context: 首次部署 flows.json 或服務時未如預期生效。
failureCaseDetailsZh.investigation: 檢查服務狀態、流程檔案位置與重新部署方式。
failureCaseDetailsZh.response: 調整部署流程並記錄問題。
failureCaseDetailsZh.lesson: 自動化流程需要部署紀錄，不只是視覺化 flow 設計。

failureCaseDetailsZh.failure: 裝置離線或無法重新連線
failureCaseDetailsZh.context: 網路切換、服務中斷或重新啟動後，裝置可能停止回報。
failureCaseDetailsZh.investigation: 檢視 reconnect、buffering 與 retry 行為。
failureCaseDetailsZh.response: 規劃重連與可能的訊息暫存機制。
failureCaseDetailsZh.lesson: 裝置曾經連線成功，不等於系統具備可靠性。

failureCaseDetailsZh.failure: 路由器設定造成網路中斷
failureCaseDetailsZh.context: 調整 OpenWrt、ASUS 或 Xiaomi router 拓撲時可能造成連線中斷。
failureCaseDetailsZh.investigation: 檢查拓撲、管理 IP 與復原步驟。
failureCaseDetailsZh.response: 在後續修改前先記錄拓撲與回復步驟。
failureCaseDetailsZh.lesson: 路由器、主機、容器與裝置問題需要分層排查。

projects.title: ESP32 Communication and Network Security Experiments
projects.titleZh: ESP32 通訊資安與網路安全實驗
projects.summary: Experiments with ESP32, MQTT, and a local network environment for device communication security, message verification, replay protection, device trust, and network boundaries.
projects.summaryZh: 使用 ESP32、MQTT 與本地網路環境，研究裝置通訊、訊息驗證、重放攻擊、裝置信任與網路邊界等問題。
listingSummary: Uses ESP32, MQTT, and a local network environment to study device communication security.
The focus is message verification, replay protection, device trust, and network boundaries.
The notes are still being organized, so this remains an experiment and research direction rather than a finished product.
listingSummaryZh: 使用 ESP32、MQTT 與本地網路環境，研究裝置通訊、訊息驗證、重放攻擊、裝置信任與網路邊界等問題。
重點不是一般嵌入式練習，而是裝置訊息如何被驗證、如何避免重放，以及裝置該如何被信任。
目前仍在整理實驗紀錄與驗證假設。
projects.researchQuestion: How can edge devices report data in a way that is observable, verifiable, and resistant to simple replay assumptions?
projects.researchQuestionZh: 邊緣裝置如何以可觀察、可驗證並避免簡單重放假設的方式回報資料？
projects.problem: ESP32 devices need clearer assumptions around message authenticity, replay behavior, local network boundaries, and device trust.
projects.problemZh: ESP32 裝置通訊需要釐清訊息真實性、重放行為、本地網路邊界與裝置信任假設。
projects.approach: ESP32 and MQTT experiments with HMAC-style message validation, replay-aware design notes, local network observation, and failure records.
projects.approachZh: 以 ESP32 與 MQTT 實驗為基礎，整理 HMAC 訊息驗證、重放防護、本地網路觀察與失敗紀錄。
projects.limitations: Experiment notes are incomplete and still being organized.
projects.limitationsZh: 實驗筆記尚未完整整理。
projects.nextSteps: Document device message format and validation assumptions.
projects.nextStepsZh: 整理裝置訊息格式與驗證假設。
keyDecisions: Start from observable device messages before claiming a security model
challenges: Hardware and firmware details need clearer separation
lessons: Device-side trust needs observable message behavior
projects.nextEngineeringStep: Document MQTT message format, HMAC validation assumptions, replay-protection notes, and local network boundaries

engineeringDomains.name: Software Engineering
engineeringDomains.whatIBuild: Frontend/backend prototypes, APIs, authentication flows, and data-backed internal tools.

engineeringDomains.name: Embedded and Device Systems
engineeringDomains.whatIBuild: Small-device experiments around communication, sensing, device state, and reporting behavior.

engineeringDomains.name: Infrastructure and Systems
engineeringDomains.whatIBuild: Linux-based lab environments, service integration, network experiments, and repeatable deployment records.

engineeringDomains.name: Cybersecurity Engineering
engineeringDomains.whatIBuild: Security controls and analysis around identity, authorization, signed messages, replay assumptions, auditability, and device trust.

engineeringProcess.title: Understand the Problem
engineeringProcess.description: Understand users, requirements, limitations, environment, and security risks.
engineeringProcess.descriptionZh: 了解使用者、需求、限制、環境與安全風險。

engineeringProcess.title: Define the System
engineeringProcess.description: Separate devices, communication, backend, frontend, storage, and security boundaries.
engineeringProcess.descriptionZh: 拆分裝置、通訊、後端、前端、儲存與安全邊界。

engineeringProcess.title: Build a Small Prototype
engineeringProcess.description: Build the smallest prototype that can actually run and be checked.
engineeringProcess.descriptionZh: 先完成可以實際運作和驗證的最小原型。

engineeringProcess.title: Test Failure Cases
engineeringProcess.description: Test wrong permissions, abnormal inputs, replayed packets, service interruption, and offline devices.
engineeringProcess.descriptionZh: 測試錯誤權限、異常輸入、封包重送、服務中斷與裝置離線。

engineeringProcess.title: Document Decisions
engineeringProcess.description: Record architecture, commands, errors, fixes, limitations, and unresolved problems.
engineeringProcess.descriptionZh: 記錄架構、指令、錯誤、修正方式、限制與尚未解決的問題。

engineeringProcess.title: Improve with Evidence
engineeringProcess.description: Improve based on test results, system records, and user feedback.
engineeringProcess.descriptionZh: 根據測試結果、系統紀錄與使用者回饋持續改善。

timeline.title: HPC learning and teaching transfer planning
timeline.output: Completed Linux, MPI, GPU, and SPECFEM3D operations; started planning a high-school experience course.
timeline.outputZh: 完成 Linux、MPI、GPU 與 SPECFEM3D 操作，開始規劃轉化為高中體驗課程。
timeline.impact: Opened an exploratory HPC direction while keeping claims limited to learning and teaching transfer.

timeline.title: Healthcare security prototype organization
timeline.output: Organized FastAPI, JWT, RBAC, MQTT signing, replay protection, and audit log prototype evidence.
timeline.outputZh: 整理 FastAPI、JWT、RBAC、MQTT 簽章、Replay Protection 與稽核紀錄原型證據。
timeline.impact: Connected healthcare workflow concerns with concrete security engineering work.

timeline.title: Research direction consolidation
timeline.output: Grouped current work into healthcare security, infrastructure security, embedded systems, applied web security, and HPC.
timeline.outputZh: 將目前工作整理為醫療資安、基礎設施安全、嵌入式系統、應用 Web 安全與 HPC。
timeline.impact: Made the portfolio easier to review for admission and research collaboration.

timeline.title: Public project pages
timeline.output: Published case study pages for NIHS Control Team, Medical Cybersecurity, and Autonomous Robot.
timeline.outputZh: 建立 NIHS Control Team、Medical Cybersecurity 與 Autonomous Robot 的公開案例頁。
timeline.impact: Preserved real project context without presenting prototypes as finished products.

futureDirection: Deepen applied cybersecurity research methodology and avoid treating prototypes as final products.
Strengthen computer science, networking, operating systems, and security fundamentals during university study.
Explore healthcare information security, industrial and embedded systems, and secure infrastructure in a lab setting.
Prepare clearer public documentation that separates evidence, assumptions, limitations, and next steps.
futureDirectionZh: 深化應用資安研究方法，避免把原型包裝成完成產品。
在大學階段補強計算機科學、網路、作業系統與安全基礎。
希望在實驗室環境中探索醫療資訊安全、工業與嵌入式系統、可信基礎設施。
持續整理公開文件，清楚區分證據、假設、限制與下一步。
